source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorems 3.2--3.3 give IPW-Z asymptotic normality under scaled inverse-propensity convergence, and the clipped-LinUCB example reports bimodal convergence modes and non-Gaussian IPW-Z behavior.

Theorem 5.14 proves a fixed-horizon realized-QV studentized CLT without deterministic variance stabilization; Design A has random post-burn-in variance regimes and regime-dependent fixed-variance coverage.
The paper introduces directional stability as weaker than target-agnostic stability and proves asymptotic normality and efficiency under that condition.
